summary.en: While on the way to a Yoko Okino concert Kogoro loses his ticket. Luck seems to be on his side when a young lady named Masayo Aoshima has an extra ticket, but the concert ends up being the last thing on their minds when they walk into her sister Mina's house and comes upon an apparent suicide. Conan has his own suspicions though, since he has caught Masayo laughing hard, but can he find enough evidence to prove contrary when the victim is found in a sealed room?
